reason: Production-readiness expansion is in progress for exact WooCommerce 11.0.0 and 11.0.1. Existing evidence covers the product/catalog, upgrade, typed-table, product lookup, lifecycle, and fail-closed deletion contracts; fresh-process category/brand hierarchy repair is now closed offline. Certification is withheld until the remaining Brands, external-product, visibility/POS, COGS, term-meta, exact settings-inventory, and final-SHA live matrices are complete.

unsupported.reason: Product reverse references can live in downloads, subscriptions, order metadata, serialized values, and extension-owned custom tables that the v1 guard grammar cannot close safely.
Variation reverse references and parent/group relationships share the same open WooCommerce extension boundary as products.
The v1 guard/cascade grammar cannot express WooCommerce global-attribute semantic deletion.
Shipping-zone and tax-rate rows require version-pinned WooCommerce API, cache, child-row, and option-name effects that are not a closed semantic delete contract.
Orders, customers, sessions, stock reservations, and Action Scheduler rows remain runtime-sovereign.
